players.product: Turnkey HPC data-center campuses leased to hyperscalers (Barber Lake, Black Pearl, Stingray - Texas) - ex-Bitcoin-mining, now 'Cipher Digital'

quarterly_data.signal: Cipher Digital's October 2026 investor presentation (figures as of September 30, 2026): 700 MW of contracted gross HPC capacity, $16.6 Bn of contracted revenue (+46% vs. Q2), a portfolio weighted average lease term of 17.3 years (+36% vs. Q2) and $843 MM of average annualized net operating income (average monthly NOI from August 2026 to July 2041, through the end of the Black Pearl base lease term, multiplied by twelve). Cipher cites 907 MW of operating and contracted capacity, including three data center campus leases with hyperscalers, and ~3.4 GW of near-term grid capacity energizing across 2027-2030+.
quarterly_data.figure: 700 MW contracted gross HPC capacity; $16.6 Bn contracted revenue (+46% vs. Q2); 17.3 years WALT; $843 MM average annualized NOI; 907 MW operating and contracted; ~3.4 GW near-term grid pipeline

quarterly_data.signal: Barber Lake per the October 2026 presentation: the amended lease is a $9.1 Bn contracted revenue commitment with a 20-year base lease term; $480mm of additional revenue is generated by rentalizing $187mm of additional costs to complete (based on the estimated cost to complete as of 10/06/2026). Construction remains on track to meet the amended delivery milestones with no rent credits incurred to date, the tenant is deploying compute throughout the facility, and equipment is fully secured.
quarterly_data.figure: $9.1 Bn contracted revenue; $480mm additional revenue from $187mm rentalized costs to complete; no rent credits incurred to date

quarterly_data.signal: Construction and pipeline status per the October 2026 presentation: at Black Pearl, the remaining Phase I data halls are progressing through MEP fit-out and Phase II concrete foundations, building steel and electrical work are in progress, with an updated phased delivery schedule being implemented with the tenant; at Stingray, earthwork, grading and pad preparation are progressing on schedule, underground electrical work has commenced and concrete foundations and steel erection are underway. Cipher says it has acquired 3,600+ acres to expand its footprint and has purchased fungible long-lead equipment, such as chillers and substations, to de-risk future builds.
quarterly_data.figure: 3,600+ acres acquired; long-lead chillers and substations purchased
